masking: Official MobileSAM with 16 deterministic RGB-derived positive prompts; no GT masks.
patching: Native 256x256 non-overlapping tiles, resize to 252 for DINO stride14, black background.
scoring: Mean of largest 0.1% of stitched instrument-region anomaly values.
calibration: Per-instrument validation F1; ties lower false-positive rate then smaller threshold.
checkpoint_selection: Validation macro F1, then lower macro FPR, then earlier checkpoint.
evaluation_status: Development comparison; this test cohort was previously inspected for PatchCore.
training_precision: CUDA BF16 with FP32 positive-kernel sums; FP32 inference.
